P.name: Determination
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Xin Zhao's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ais|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' first slash hit and thrust on at least one enemy hit each generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Determination'', stacking up to 3 times. The third stack {{tt|consumes them|See notes for consumption details}} all to deal {{as|{{pp|15 to 60 for 4|key=%|1 to 16|formula=15% + 15% every 5 levels}} AD}} {{as|(+ {{pp|5 to 20 for 4|1;6;11;16|key=%}} AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|heal}} '''Xin Zhao''' for {{as|{{pp|2 to 5|key=%|1;6;11}} of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{pp|40;50;70|1;6;11|key=%}} AP)}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Challenge:}} ''{{ai|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' and, if ''{{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}}'' has been learned, '''Xin Zhao's''' basic attacks and ''{{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}}'', apply a {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} mark to certain enemies hit for 3 seconds. Only one enemy can be marked as {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} at a time; applying the mark to a new target removes it from the previous one. ''{{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}}'' and ''{{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}}'' have interactions against {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} targets.

Q.name: Three Talon Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xin Zhao''' empowers his next three {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} within 5 seconds to each have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and reduce his other {{tip|ability|abilities'}} {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} by 1 second. Each attack refreshes the duration.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|15 to 75}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|15*3 to 75*3}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: The third attack {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} the target for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
Q.description3: ''Three Talon Strike's'' '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.description4: ''Three Talon Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Xin Zhao's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Xin Zhao''' unleashes {{tt|4 slashes|First slash happens on-cast instantly, while the remaining 3 are applied every 0.05 seconds thereafter}} in an arc over the first {{fd|0.15}} seconds of the cast time, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within. After the remaining cast time, he then thrusts his spear in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 33.3 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.33 * critical strike chance}}|critical chance}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% for {{fd|1.5}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}} per 100 AP)}} seconds. ''Wind Becomes Lightning'' deals {{pp|50 to 100 for 16|key=%}} damage to {{tip|minions}}.

The farthest {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} hit within the thrust's area is also marked as ''{{ai|Challenged|Xin Zhao|border=false}}'' and is {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 3 seconds.
W.description2: ''Wind Becomes Lightning's'' damage {{tip|healing|heals}} '''Xin Zhao''' for {{fd|33.{{recurring|3}}}}% of his {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
W.description3:
''The durations of {{ai|Three Talon Strike|Xin Zhao}} and {{ais|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} are delayed relative to Wind Becomes Lightning's cast time.
'''Xin Zhao''' {{tip|sight|reveals}} himself during the cast if there is an enemy champion {{tt|nearby|see details}}''.

E.name: Audacious Charge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xin Zhao''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} all targets hit by 30% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. ''Audacious Charge's'' range is increased against ''{{ai|Challenged|Xin Zhao|border=false}}'' targets.
E.description2: '''Xin Zhao''' then gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
E.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|38 to 70}}% {{as|(+ 10% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% per 5% '''bonus''' attack speed from non-buff sources)|as}}}}
E.description3: ''{{ai|Three Talon Strike|Xin Zhao}} and {{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Crescent Guard
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Xin Zhao's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''{{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}}'' apply the ''{{ai|Challenged|Xin Zhao|border=false}}'' mark to enemy {{tip|champions}} hit, with the latter applying the mark to the farthest champion hit in the area of effect or the primary target if they are a champion.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xin Zhao''' sweeps his spear around him, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, capped at 600 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, and {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} all targets hit that are not ''{{ai|Challenged|Xin Zhao|border=false}}'' up-to 700 units over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, as well as {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for the same duration.
R.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|75 to 275}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}} {{as|(+ 15% of target's '''current''' health)}}}}
R.description3: For the next 4 seconds, '''Xin Zhao''' is {{tip|invulnerable}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} far away from him.
